name: Efka Engineering System
scope: Standalone control layer: readiness, gates, a fail-closed execution boundary, contracts, and evidence. Other systems (model gateway, eval, agent runtimes) are external modules that are verified, never installed.

components.purpose: readiness of toolchain, agent surfaces, MCP, repos, secret files, disk
doctor + secret scan + sandbox preflight + every adapters/*/verify.ps1, with JSON/TXT logs and 60-run retention
fail-closed execution boundary: pinned image, no network, read-only rootfs, single mount, non-root, memory/cpu/pid limits, timeout, evidence receipt
10 observable cases proving the boundary holds (network, rootfs, mount, limits, timeout, env, receipt)
refuses task contracts without a testable goal, bounded scope, acceptance commands, stop condition, time budget and trust profile; writes logs/jobs/<job_id>/state.json
5 cases: template admitted, missing acceptance / unpinned sandbox image / malformed job_id rejected, JSON input accepted
high-confidence credential scan by filename and content
enforces the review contract: evidence per finding, observed tests for approve, independence flag, receipt agreement
new project with AGENTS.md, .gitignore, .gitattributes, check.ps1, git baseline
TaskSpec, ExecutionSpec, JobState, definition of done
per-action evidence receipt schema (mirrored by the executor receipt)
agent skill: run and interpret the gate
INSTALL, ARCHITECTURE, MODULES, GATES, SANDBOX, CONTRACTS, ADDONS, MEMORY, TOOLCHAIN, SCORE, GEMS

invariants: core/ contains no host names, user paths, or product-specific logic
no credential values in the repository; configuration reads environment variables
installs are generated from this repository; no manual copies
every check is read-only and returns a meaningful exit code
unsupported capability means BLOCKED, never a silent fallback
a review finding without evidence is rejected by the validator
a test claimed as pass must match the receipt the executor wrote
images are pulled by a human, never by the system
work does not start without an admitted task contract
third-party agent content is opt-in, pinned, attributed, and never vendored

adapters.description: Host/module-specific layers live outside core/ and are never copied to other machines.
adapters.contract: adapters/<name>/verify.ps1 is executed automatically by the gate as section adapter:<name>

addons.description: Opt-in third-party agent content (skills/plugins). EES ships only the pinned, consent-gated wrapper; nothing is vendored, nothing is installed automatically. Gate section: integration:<name>.

installed.name: understand-anything
installed.delivers: 9 skills: understand, understand-chat, understand-dashboard, understand-diff, understand-domain, understand-explain, understand-figma, understand-knowledge, understand-onboard

runtime_dependency.name: rootless podman in WSL
runtime_dependency.note: The executor uses an existing rootless Podman and a locally present pinned image. It never installs Podman, configures it, or pulls images.

not_in_scope: installing or configuring container runtimes and images
